Privacy Policy

Your information deserves thoughtful care.

Website edition · Updated 17 October 2026

On this page

01

About this policy

This policy explains privacy on the Favorite Hearts information website and how to contact us with privacy questions. The website presents our matrimony vision, articles, and support information. It does not currently provide profile registration, matching, identity verification, or payment collection. Separate, updated information will be needed before those services become available.

02

Information you share

If you email or message Favorite Hearts, the channel you choose shares your contact details and message with us. This may include your name, email address, phone number, attachments, and information you choose to provide about an enquiry. Please send only what is needed; do not send passwords, one-time codes, or identity documents in an initial message.

03

Browsing and technical information

The current website code does not submit your FAQ or newsroom searches to Favorite Hearts, and it does not add advertising analytics or use browser local storage for profiles. Search and filter operations happen in your browser. When you continue through the welcome screen, your language and country preferences are stored locally in your browser to remember your choice and set the initial pricing currency. This preference is not a member profile or precise-location lookup. You can change it through the home-page footer or remove it by clearing website data. Hosting, access-control, and network providers may process technical information such as an IP address, browser details, and request logs to deliver and protect the website. Their own privacy notices also apply to their services.

04

How information is used

Information you provide in an enquiry is used to understand and respond to that enquiry, handle a concern, and communicate with you about it. Technical processing supports website delivery and security. The applicable basis for processing depends on the activity and law, including responding to a requested service, legitimate operational needs where permitted, legal obligations, or consent where required. A support enquiry does not automatically sign you up for promotional messages.

05

External services and links

This site links to WhatsApp, Facebook, TikTok, and email services. Opening a link takes you to a service governed by its own terms and privacy practices. Some photographs are loaded from an external image provider; your browser sends a network request to that provider to display them. Service providers involved in hosting and communications may process information as part of providing their services. Information may also need to be disclosed when legally required.

06

Storage, retention, and international processing

Hosting and communication providers may process information outside Sri Lanka. Their processing locations and retention practices vary. Enquiry information should be kept only for as long as needed to handle the matter and meet applicable obligations; there is no single published retention period for every type of enquiry. Contact us for details about a particular message or request. Provider-level technical logs may have separate retention periods.

07

Your choices and requests

You can ask about personal information you have shared with Favorite Hearts, request a correction or deletion, or raise an objection or consent-withdrawal request where applicable. The rights available and any exceptions depend on applicable law and the circumstances. Email hello@favoritehearts.com with the subject “Privacy request”. We may need proportionate information to confirm that a request comes from the right person. You may also contact the relevant data protection authority about a concern.

08

Privacy and safety

Favorite Hearts is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Please contact us if you believe a child’s personal information has been shared with us. Do not submit sensitive information about another person without appropriate authority. No website or messaging channel can promise absolute security; choose carefully what you share and tell us if you notice a privacy or security concern.

09

Updates and contact

We will update this page when the website or relevant practices change, and revise the date shown above. New account, payment, or verification features require further privacy information before they are introduced. For questions about this policy, contact Favorite Hearts at hello@favoritehearts.com or visit Contact Us.
